title: TANDEMISE_NODE points nowhere: the message names the setting, not a crash

checks.label: names TANDEMISE_NODE and the path
checks.detail:
The Tandemise daemon is not running

TANDEMISE_NODE is set to /nonexistent/bin/node, but there is no runnable file there. Point it at a Node 22+ binary (run which node in a terminal to find one), or unset it, then press Retry.

Looking for the handshake file at
/tmp/tdm-retry/home-bad-override/daemon.json
Retry

Tandemise will try to start the daemon for you. If that keeps failing, start it by hand with npm run daemon and press Retry.
